arabic_text: وَلأِهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعاً وَمُحْتشداً مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْب أَذْنَبْنَاهُ، أَوْ سُوْء أَسْلَفْنَاهُ، أَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ أَضْمَرْنَاهُ، تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْطَوِيْ عَلَى رُجُوع إلَى ذَنْب وَلا يَعُودُ بَعْدَهَا فِي خَطِيئَة،
transliteration: wa li-ahli millatika majmaʿan wa muhtashidan min kulli dhanbin adhnabnahu ʾaw suwʾa aslafnāhū, ʾaw khāṭir sharri ʾaḍmarnāhū tawbatu man lā yanṭawī ʿalā rujūʿ ilā dhamb wa lā yaʿūd baʿdahā fī khaṭīʾah
english_text: and for the people of Thy creed a time of assembly and gathering, from every misdeed we did, ill work we sent ahead, or evil thought we secretly conceived, the repentance of one who does not harbour a return to sin and who afterwards will not go back to offense,

arabic_text: تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالارْتِيَابِ،
transliteration: tawbatan naṣūḥan khalaṣat mina alshakki walirtiyābi
english_text: an unswerving repentance rid of doubt and wavering.

arabic_text: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا وَارْضَ عَنَّا وَثَبِّتنَا عَلَيْهَا.
transliteration: fataqabbalhā minnā, warḍa ʿannā, wathabbitnā ʿalayhā
english_text: So accept it from us, be pleased with us, and fix us within it!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا خَوْفَ عِقَابِ الْوَعِيدِ، وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتّى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهِ، وكَأْبَةَ مَا نَسْتَجِيْرُكَ مِنْهُ،
transliteration: allāhumma arzuqnā khawfa ʿiqābi al-waʿīd wa shawqa thawabi al-maw'oodi hatta najida ladhdhata ma nad'ooka bihi waka'bat ma nastaajiruka minhu
english_text: God, provide us with fear of the threatened punishment and yearning for the promised reward, so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate Thee and the sorrow of that from which we seek sanctuary in Thee!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ، وَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ، يَا أَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ.
transliteration: wa-jaʿalna ʿinda-ka mina ttawwabiyna llaḏiyna 'awjabta lahum maḥabbataka wa qabilta minhum murajaaʿata taʿatika, yaa aʿdala al-ʿaadiliin
english_text: And place us with Thee among the repenters, those upon whom Thou hast made Thy love obligatory and from whom Thou hast accepted the return to obeying Thee! O Most Just of the just!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبآئِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَهْلِ دِيْنِنَا جَمِيعاً مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
transliteration: allāhumma tajāwaz ʿan ābāʾinā wa ʾummahātinā wa ahli dīninā jamīʿan man salafa minhum wa man ghabara ila yawm al-qiyamah
english_text: O God, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion, those who have gone and those who will pass by, until the Day of Resurrection!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد نَبِيِّنَا وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad nabiyyinā wa ālih kamā ṣallayta ʿalā malāʾikatika almuqarrabīn
english_text: O God, bless our prophet Muhammad and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy angels brought nigh,

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَأَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
transliteration: waṣallī ʿalayhi wa ālihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā anbiyāika al-mursalīn wa ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ālihi, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā ʿibādika aṣ-ṣāliḥ wa afḍala min dhālika yā rab al-ʿālamīn
english_text: bless him and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy prophets sent out, bless him and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy righteous servants - and better than that, O Lord of the worlds!

arabic_text: صَلاَةً تَبْلُغُنَا بَرَكَتُهَا، وَيَنَالُنَا نَفْعُهَا، وَيُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا دُعَاؤُنَا،
transliteration: ṣalātan tablugunā barakatuhā, wa yanālunā nafʿuhā wayustajābu lahā duʿā'unā
english_text: a blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain to us, and through which our supplication may be granted!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ وَأكْفَى مَنْ تُوُكِّلَ عَلَيْهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ سُئِلَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
transliteration: 'innaka akramu man rughiba ilayhi wa akfā man tuwukkila ʿalayh wa-aʿṭā man suʾila min faḍlihi wa-anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
english_text: Thou art the most generous of those who are beseeched, the most sufficient of those in whom confidence is had, the most bestowing of those from whom bounty is asked, and Thou art powerful over everything!
